page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, operating at a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage operations must rely on attached network volumes. Network connectivity is capped at a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

A key technical constraint of this instance is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. The processor lacks support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography instructions such as AES and SHA_NI. Hyper-threading is also disabled, limiting parallel execution to the two physical cores.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides entry-level GPU acceleration paired with a modest compute and memory profile. It is designed for workloads that require GPU-assisted processing but do not demand high CPU core counts or large memory footprints. Suitable workloads include lightweight machine learning inference, basic video transcoding, and GPU-accelerated rendering tasks that fit within the 8 GB VRAM and 8 GB system memory boundaries.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an entry-level GPU-accelerated instance featuring two dedicated x86_64 physical cores and 8.0 GB of system memory. It integrates a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM to accelerate parallel computing tasks. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Notably, it lacks local storage, requiring network-attached storage for data persistence. Additionally, the CPU configuration lacks support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, and hardware cryptography extensions like AES. With a modest 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance represents a low-density GPU option. It is suited for lightweight GPU workloads, including small-scale machine learning inference, basic media transcoding, and development environments requiring hardware acceleration without high CPU or memory overhead.
